name: Terraform Structure Standards
description: Terraform guidance to adapt when converting to MDC. Regex patterns are illustrative, not enforcement or complete detection. Based on terraform-infrastructure.md and project-specific-standards.md.
author: Promptcraft

rules.message: Terraform files should follow standard structure: main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, providers.tf, versions.tf

Enable encryption and state locking supported by the backend and pinned Terraform version. S3 supports use_lockfile; DynamoDB locking is deprecated and coexistence is only a legacy-client migration option. See https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/backend/s3#state-locking
Terraform version should be pinned in versions.tf
Provider versions should be pinned in versions.tf
